rules.title: Document uses heading styles
rules.recommendation: Apply built-in Heading styles to section titles.

rules.title: Heading levels do not skip
rules.recommendation: Use sequential heading levels without skipping.

rules.title: First heading is Heading 1
rules.recommendation: Start the document outline with Heading 1.

rules.title: Headings are not empty
rules.recommendation: Add heading text or change the paragraph style to Normal.

rules.title: Visual headings use heading styles
rules.recommendation: If this text is a section title, apply a Heading style instead of manual formatting.

rules.title: Lists use real list formatting
rules.recommendation: Replace typed bullets or numbers with Word list formatting.

rules.title: No empty paragraphs used for spacing
rules.recommendation: Remove empty paragraphs and use paragraph spacing instead.

rules.title: Long document has a table of contents
rules.recommendation: Insert an automatic table of contents built from the headings.

rules.title: Link text is descriptive
rules.recommendation: Replace raw URLs and phrases like 'click here' with text that says where the link goes.

rules.title: No repeated spaces used for layout
rules.recommendation: Use indents, tab stops or tables instead of repeated spaces.

rules.title: Images have alt text
rules.recommendation: Add alt text, or mark the image as decorative.

rules.title: Alt text is not a placeholder
rules.recommendation: Replace the file name or placeholder with a description of the image.

rules.title: Auto-generated alt text is reviewed
rules.recommendation: Check the generated description against the image and correct it.

rules.title: Alt text accurately describes each image
rules.recommendation: Have a person confirm that the alt text conveys the image's purpose.

rules.title: Document title is set
rules.recommendation: Set a descriptive title in File > Info > Properties.

rules.title: Document author is set
rules.recommendation: Set the author in File > Info > Properties.

rules.title: Default document language is set
rules.recommendation: Set the proofing language in the document defaults or Normal style.

rules.title: Default language tag is valid
rules.recommendation: Use a valid language tag such as en-US or hi-IN.

rules.title: Language changes are identified
rules.recommendation: Have a person confirm that foreign-language passages carry the right proofing language.

rules.title: No unresolved tracked changes or comments
rules.recommendation: Accept or reject tracked changes and resolve comments before release.

rules.title: Content is not in text boxes
rules.recommendation: Move text box content into the main document flow.

rules.title: Objects are inline with text
rules.recommendation: Set the object's wrapping to 'In line with text'.

rules.title: Multi-column reading order is correct
rules.recommendation: Have a person confirm that the column content reads in the right order.

rules.title: Essential content is not only in headers or footers
rules.recommendation: Have a person confirm that header and footer text is repeated in the body if it is essential.

rules.title: Tabs are not used to fake tables
rules.recommendation: Convert tab-aligned rows into a real table.

rules.title: Tables have a marked header row
rules.recommendation: Turn on 'Repeat as header row at the top of each page' for the first row.

rules.title: Tables have no merged cells
rules.recommendation: Split merged cells and use a simple table grid.

rules.title: Tables are not nested
rules.recommendation: Replace the nested table with a simple table or separate tables.

rules.title: Tables have no blank rows or columns
rules.recommendation: Remove blank rows and columns and use cell spacing instead.

rules.title: Tables have a title or description
rules.recommendation: Add a title or description in Table Properties > Alt Text.

rules.title: Tables are not used only for layout
rules.recommendation: Have a person confirm that this holds tabular data; otherwise replace it with normal layout.

rules.title: Text meets the minimum contrast ratio
rules.recommendation: Change the text or background color to reach 4.5:1, or 3:1 for large text.

rules.title: Text is not too small
rules.recommendation: Increase the font size.

rules.title: Color is not the only way of conveying meaning
rules.recommendation: Have a person confirm that colored text also signals its meaning another way.

rules.title: Body text is not justified
rules.recommendation: Use left alignment.

rules.title: Long passages are not in all caps
rules.recommendation: Use sentence case, with bold or a heading style for emphasis.

rules.title: Verified with NVDA
rules.recommendation: Test the document with NVDA and record the evidence.

rules.title: Verified with JAWS
rules.recommendation: Test the document with JAWS and record the evidence.
